name: Tamara Puhovski
title: Social Impact and Learning Advisor
bio: Tamara is a sociologist and political scientist with over 25 years of experience spanning civic engagement, public policy, and social impact. She combines rigorous research and data-informed management with unconventional thinking and social innovation. Her work spans open government, human rights, and inclusion, helping organisations understand how institutions and technologies shape people’s lives and translate evidence into meaningful change, with particular attention to people whose voices are overlooked and whose needs remain unseen.
